mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.role, u.password_hash, u.auth_version FROM login_identifiers li JOIN users u ON u.id = li.user_id WHERE li.identifier = #{identifier}
SELECT auth_version FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE student_record_id = #{studentRecordId})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = #{email})
SELECT u.id, ms.student_no, ms.real_name, ms.campus_card_no, u.nickname, u.email, u.phone, u.role, u.version FROM users u LEFT JOIN mock_students ms ON ms.id = u.student_record_id WHERE u.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET auth_version = auth_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, phone = #{phone}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
UPDATE users SET email = #{email}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, auth_version = auth_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (student_record_id, role, nickname, email, phone, password_hash) VALUES (#{studentRecordId}, #{role}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{passwordHash})
